welcome.title: New to the menu?
body: This menu is where you make your character, change clothes and get cars. The guide shows you where each one is.
It takes about two minutes.
welcome.foot: Skip it now and find it later at the top of the menu: **Player Guide**.

steps.title: Find your way around
body: [F1] opens and closes this menu. [↑] [↓] move, [ENTER] picks and [BACKSPACE] goes back a page.
The mouse works too: left-click picks and right-click goes back.
steps.tip: Change any vMenu key in **Pause → Settings → Key Bindings → FiveM**. Look for "vMenu".

steps.title: Make your character
body: Pick **Create Male Character** or **Create Female Character**. Choose parents, face, hair and clothes, then pick **Save Character** and give it a name.
Only characters made here can be saved and edited later.
steps.tip: Open **Saved Characters**, pick yours and choose **Set As Default Character**. With **Respawn As Default MP Character** on in Misc Settings, you spawn as them every time.

steps.title: Change clothes and save outfits
body: Dress up, open **Saved Outfits** and pick **Save Current Outfit**. Change into it later without touching your face or hair.
steps.tip: **Player Appearance → Clothing Quick Toggles** takes off your hat, glasses or mask, and puts back exactly what you had.

steps.title: Department uniforms
body: Go on duty with **/duty** and pick your department. **Department Outfits** then lists the uniforms your department has published for your body type.
Nothing shows while you're off duty.
steps.tip: Department heads publish and update these outfits from the same page.

steps.title: Get a car
body: **Custom Vehicles** opens Paradise State's vehicle packs. [F9] opens them straight away. Some packs need a role.
For standard GTA cars, pick a category further down, or type a model with **Spawn Vehicle By Model Name**.
steps.tip: You can have up to 5 vehicles out at once (3 during a purge). **/dv** deletes one you're done with.

steps.title: Keep your car
body: Tune and paint it in **Vehicle Options**, then sit in it and pick **Save Current Vehicle**. It spawns exactly the same next time.
Open the saved car from **Vehicle Class** or **Vehicle Category** and pick **Save to CAD** to register it to your character.
steps.tip: **Generate Vehicle Code** on a saved car gives a friend a code. They load it with **Load Vehicle Code**.

steps.title: Your personal vehicle
body: Drive a car as the driver and it becomes your personal vehicle.
From here you can lock and unlock it, start the engine, sound the horn and set a waypoint to it.
steps.tip: Turn on **Auto-Lock When I Walk Away** and it locks itself.

steps.title: Back up your saves
body: Your characters, outfits and cars are saved on your own PC. Clearing the FiveM cache or changing PC loses them.
**Back Up My Saves** keeps a copy on the server and **Restore My Saves** brings it back. **Auto Back Up My Saves** does it for you.

steps.title: You're all set
body: Replay this guide, or look up one question, from **Player Guide** at the top of the menu.
Still stuck? Ask on our Discord: **discord.gg/paradisestaterp**.

questions.question: How do I make a character?
How do I save an outfit?
How do I get my department uniform?
How do I get a car?
How do I save my car?
How do I register my car in the CAD?
body: Save the car first. Then open it from **Vehicle Class** or **Vehicle Category** and pick **Save to CAD**.
It's registered to the character you're playing, so a plate check shows it's yours.

questions.question: How do I lock or find my car?
How do I share an outfit or a car?
body: Open your character from **Saved Characters** and pick **Edit Saved Character**. In there, **Generate Outfit Code** gives you a code for what you're wearing, and your friend types it into **Load Shared Outfit**.
Cars work the same way: **Generate Vehicle Code** on a saved car, and **Load Vehicle Code** in Saved Vehicles.

questions.question: How do I keep my saves on a new PC?
How do I change how I walk?
body: Change **Walking Style** with [←] and [→]. It stays until you change it.

questions.question: How do I get more peds?
body: Open **Spawn Peds**. The **Ped Pack** in there has extra peds from the PSRP store, and you can preview them before you buy.

questions.question: How do I take screenshots without the HUD?
body: **Photo Mode** gives you a free camera with the HUD hidden. It stays within 15 m of you.
